## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 13 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jonathan Engstrom_, 13 oct 2026, 1/5: "Seems to work OK, except that after sitting in the hot tub, by heart rate goes up, and somehow it detects I am stressed out to the max, kinda dumb. UPDATE: This app has become total garbage in the past year or so. Says I am sleeping when I am sitting at my computer. I don't want to have to manually update sleep times because it's guesses suck. Mostly unusable at this point and useless. It's attitude that it knows best is stupid, it doesn't. Looking for replacement software."
            2. _James Anderson_, 12 oct 2026, 1/5: "App freezes often."
            3. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
<!--/ir-theme-->
